Headline: #115 Pullman/115th Temporary Reroute at 115th/Perry
ShortDescription: #115 Pullman/115th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to street blockage near 115th/Perry.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#115 Pullman/115th buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions via 115th, Wentworth, 119th, Michigan, and 115th then resume their normal route, due to street blockage near 115th/Perry.

Allow extra travel time.
